decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-7a46c2eb34a1] is the v3.0.0 changelog line under "Other work". It says commit fdf21f7 (#21247) adds "pollinate" to USERS.md. The subject is therefore the USERS.md documentation file (the list of Argo CD users), not any configuration, API, flag or runtime behaviour. The change is one added entry, and the consequence is none for any environment. That is enough to record the subject as a documentation-only, non-product subject, so further evidence would not change the assertion.
